label: Presign Media URL
description: Create a pending media upload intent and get a create-only presigned PUT URL. The scenario must PUT the bytes with every returned upload_headers entry and call POST /v1/media/confirm.

parameters.name: content_type
parameters.label: Content Type
parameters.help: Allowed media MIME type, for example image/jpeg, image/png, video/mp4, audio/mpeg, or application/pdf
